question: If capable AI can run on a phone without the internet, what changes for privacy and access?
reflection: Small models that run on everyday devices could bring useful AI to places with weak connections while keeping personal data close to home.

sources.subject: Cursor MoE Kernel, Liquid AI On-Device 2.6B Agent, Mistral 3B Safe

one_line: Labs are giving away more of their core tools, and small models are getting good enough to run useful agents on a phone.

top_stories.title: Agent model that runs on a phone
top_stories.what: Liquid AI released a small open model that it says plans steps and uses tools well while fitting in under 2.5 GB of memory on a device.
top_stories.why: On-device AI lets field researchers work with sensitive data without sending it to the cloud.

top_stories.title: Cursor shares a faster training component
top_stories.what: Cursor released free code that it says makes a key part of training large models more than twice as fast as public options.
top_stories.why: Cheaper training lowers the barrier for regional labs building their own models.

top_stories.title: Small open safety checker
top_stories.what: Mistral released a small open model for screening unsafe content that it says beats models seven times its size.
top_stories.why: A cheap local filter helps organisations add safety checks to chat services they host themselves.

saudi_lens.text: On-device models suit Saudi health and government services that must keep personal data local, though Arabic performance still needs testing.

idea.title: Offline field interview assistant
idea.pitch: A phone app that helps researchers take structured notes and summaries during field interviews, running fully on the device.
idea.first_step: Test the small model on three anonymised Arabic interview transcripts and rate the summaries.

idea_kids.title: My helper in a box
idea_kids.pitch: A craft kit where children build a cardboard helper robot and decide which secrets it keeps inside the box and never shares.
idea_kids.first_step: Design a simple box template and a set of picture cards for things to keep private.

terms.definition: AI that runs directly on a phone or laptop instead of on remote servers.
A model design where only a few specialised parts switch on for each piece of input, saving computing power.
A text model that refines a whole passage at once over several rounds instead of writing word by word.

concepts.summary: Labs sharing training code and small models openly.
Capable models that run privately on phones and laptops.
Small models that screen inputs and outputs for unsafe content.
